5686.title: Plugin descriptions conceal explanatory text
5686.rootCauseOneLine: Settings enforce single-line truncation; onboarding inherits two-line clamping while its card-body action toggles enabled state instead of opening details.
5686.proposedFix: Wrap the settings description and select an onboarding-specific full-description or separate-details policy without globally changing browsing-card clamping.
5686.caveats: Verified with actual current-main components in isolated Linux/Chrome harnesses, not desktop 0.46.1 on macOS. No automatic PR because the complete onboarding fix requires an overflow/interaction policy choice.
